'''Chapter 413''' is titled "Hunter".

==Cover Page==
[[Miss Goldenweek's "Operation: Meet Baroque Works"]], Conclusion: "Sentence Decided: The Great Prison Impel Down".

Unwilling to chance any more escapes, the [[Marines]] transfer their remaining [[Baroque Works]] arrests—[[Crocodile]], [[Daz Bonez|Mr. 1]], [[Bentham|Mr. 2]], and [[Galdino|Mr. 3]]—to [[Impel Down|the highest-security prison in the world]].

==Short Summary==
[[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and [[Kaku]] fight. [[Sogeking]] is defeated by [[Jabra]]. [[Sanji]] shows up to fight Jabra.

==Long Summary==
Everyone is running from [[Enies Lobby]] to avoid the impending [[Buster Call]]. [[Nico Robin]] is running back the way she came. [[Spandam]] tells her that if she goes back, all she will see are pirate corpses. Spandam draws [[Funkfreed]] and uses Ivory Dart to stop her. Robin is pinned between Funkfreed's left tusk and sword trunk. Outside, Franky has pulled [[Tony Tony Chopper|Chopper]] from the ocean and dragged him onto shore. Chopper has reverted to normal, but he is unconscious. As he is pumping the water out of Chopper's body, he wonders how to get to the [[Gate of Justice]]. [[Kokoro]], [[Chimney]], and [[Gonbe]] conveniently appear to show Franky the way to the Gate of Justice. Franky then has a flashback of [[Nami]] giving him a baby [[Den Den Mushi]] and the 3rd and 4th keys. Franky then leaves Chopper in the hands of Kokoro and her granddaughter and heads toward the Gate of Justice.

Back inside the tower, [[Jabra]] comments that they are wasting time, and Nami yells at [[Roronoa Zoro|Zoro]] and Sogeking for it. Zoro and [[Sogeking]] each blame the other for being an idiot. Kaku uses Rankyaku Sen, which Zoro intercepts. He tries to slice Kaku's neck, but Kaku moves his neck out of the way, saying he gained the muscles to fully control his giraffe neck. Kaku then uses Bigan which Zoro blocks. Sogeking, Jabra, and Nami are watching the swordsmen's fight from the sidelines. Sogeking then challenges Jabra.

To his surprise, Jabra tosses his key at Sogeking's feet. He tells Sogeking that he hates blood and fighting. Sogeking bends over to pick up the key. Nami tries to tell him it's a trap, but before she can Jabra attacks Sogeking with Jusshigan. Sogeking hits the wall and Nami runs over to him. Sogeking fires a Himawariboshi from his [[Kabuto]] but Jabra dodges it with [[Soru]]. Jabra then kicks Sogeking's head into the wall. Just as Jabra is about to kill Sogeking, [[Sanji]] flies in out of nowhere and lands a kick on the side of his head that sends him across the room. When Jabra asks Sanji who he is, Sanji tells him he is the hunter.
